content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DIAT Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application by email to [email protected] . Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 31-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Defence Institute of Advanced Technology (DIAT), Pune, operating under the Department of Defence Research & Development, Ministry of Defence, Government of India.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in DIAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 temporary vacancies available, which include 3 positions for Senior Research Fellow (SRF) and 3 positions for Junior Research Fellow (JRF) under the project.

faq.question: Q3. What are the eligible qualifications for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech/M.Sc./M.E./M.Tech degree in Electronics, Physics, Applied Physics, Optics, Photonics, or related engineering and science disciplines with First Division.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for Senior Research Fellow (SRF)?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) post is 32 years as on 31st October 2026, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for Junior Research Fellow (JRF)?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post is 28 years as on 31st October 2026, with relaxation rules applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. What salary will be provided to the selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a monthly stipend ranging from ₹30,000/- to ₹42,000/- plus 30% HRA depending on the specific post, such as ₹42,000/- + HRA for SRF.

faq.question: Q7. What is the last date to apply for DIAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the job application via email is 31 October 2026. Candidates must send their applications on or before this closing date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for these positions?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via email. Candidates are required to compile their signed bio-data, application form, and certificates into a single PDF and email it.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the application email be sent?
faq.answer: Applicants must send their compiled application PDF files via email to the Deputy Project Director's email address at [email protected] with the appropriate subject line.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these fellowships?
faq.answer: The selection process involves initial shortlisting of candidates based on project suitability, followed by an interview conducted either in-person or via video conferencing.
